name: Multi-part machine assembly
description: Keep parts as separate solids: place standard parts and custom envelopes, then export the assembly compound (do not fuse everything into one brick).

steps.exit_criteria: At least one housing or motor envelope exists.

steps.goal: Place moving parts, cut pockets/bores, translate/rotate into assembly positions. Prefer keep-separate; fuse only when a single printable body is required.
steps.exit_criteria: Parts positioned; bores cut where needed.

steps.goal: Insert catalog bearings, fasteners, gear blanks, motor.
Export finished assembly (primary body or full compound).
